description.value: Over about nine days the bodies of a valley work along one head of the lowland, cropping and turning the vent crust in a band roughly two hundred metres deep, and then move to the next head. In sixty-eight years of observation no head has been taken out of order and no ground has been worked twice in a cycle. The plume composition changes about four hours before the bodies do, which is the only notice anybody gets and is not addressed to anybody. A descent into a head that is being worked is answered inside the hour by a shift in the signature that the instruments read as a wall and the descent teams have learned to read as one: it has happened three times, and on the third occasion the probe was recovered upslope of where it had been left. Nothing is retrieved from the front, including a body separated from it.
Telesa doline devet dni obdelujejo eno glavo nižavja in nato v ustaljenem redu preidejo na naslednjo.

periodicity: one head every nine days, without a break
